checks.name: Durable resume
checks.output: 23 tests prove queued, running and paused attempts, checkpoints, evidence, leases and monotonic journals survive database/controller/server close and reopen before an exact-checkpoint resume

checks.name: Lease exclusion
checks.output: segment-prefix overlap is denied transactionally across two SQLite connections and two controllers; a concurrent same-path race has one winner, while terminal transitions release leases atomically

checks.name: Immutable base
checks.output: candidate-tree, branch, HEAD, dirty-path and detached-worktree drift are refused; controller selection and resume deny repository or isolated-allocation drift before an effect

checks.name: Build budget
checks.output: 9 tests cover fixed typed recipes, wall and CPU termination, bounded captured output, writable-file ceiling, PID pre-spawn denial, missing host accounting denial and descendant process-group cleanup

checks.name: Git broker
checks.output: leased exact paths at the admitted base produce one deterministic candidate tree and one namespaced proposal ref; exact verified candidates advance local and origin main only through expected-tip non-force CAS receipts

checks.name: Forbidden Git
checks.output: generic push, merge, force, reset, checkout, rebase, stash, tag, remote edit and history rewrite requests are absent or explicitly denied; tests use temporary local repositories and remotes

checks.name: Provider boundary
checks.output: 7 tests require loader-derived inventory and surface digests, bounded host policy, sufficient capability evidence, safe declared modes and explicit ordered fallbacks; unknown, debug, unsafe and experimental modes are denied

checks.name: Scenario client
checks.command: bun test sdk/typescript/packages/lab/test && npx --offline tsc -p sdk/typescript/packages/lab/tsconfig.json
checks.output: 24 tests and 90 assertions cover select, observe, exact-checkpoint resume, cancel, idempotent receipts, request/response coordinates, cursors, direct bounded framing, abort and timeout; offline strict typecheck passes

checks.name: Recovery
checks.command: python3 -m unittest tools.test_git_broker tools.test_local_integration tools.test_lab_state tools.test_lab_controller tools.test_lab_scenario
checks.output: intent-only and ref-before-receipt Git windows reconcile to one commit/effect; atomic action replay has one state transition; controller/server restart resumes durable state; a live interrupted build fails closed without respawn pending external PID-identity reconciliation

limitations: the controller is synthetic-only; real provider modes remain denied until runtime lifecycle evidence is observed
the same-user local socket server is Linux-only, sequential and one-request-per-connection
the TypeScript framed transport uses an injected authenticated channel; Unix socket authentication belongs to the outer connector
an already-spawned build whose controller identity is lost fails closed and requires external PID-identity reconciliation rather than unsafe adoption or duplicate execution
full plan completion still requires one atomic exact-tree transaction containing this evidence, the done transition, regenerated artifacts, post-completion metrics and history
notes: The implementation is a proposal-only development harness and does not use the unfinished product daemon or provider credentials. Deterministic checks are not described as independent review. R0-19 must remain open until atomic completion records are landed.
